title: 以为只是偶发故障？：花旗CEO补丁量，是此前五到十倍
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: It does seem like this hasn't been a great week for tech trust.
segments.zh: 这周科技信任度确实不太行。

segments.en: When it comes to trusting our technology, considering the FAA went down and so did Apple and JP Morgan experienced problems.
segments.zh: 说到对技术的信任，FAA系统宕机，苹果和摩根大通也出了问题。

segments.en: There have been all these tech outages. Should we go by gold bars?
segments.zh: 这么多技术故障，我们该去买金条吗？

segments.en: Look, I can empathize a lot as to why this is unsettling at the moment.
segments.zh: 我完全理解为什么现在让人不安。

segments.en: There's been a lot in the last couple of weeks.
segments.zh: 过去几周发生了很多事。

segments.en: But let's take a little bit of a step back.
And I just give some reassurance.
The volume of changes, the patches, that is going through the world's tech stack at the same time
segments.zh: 全球技术栈同时进行的变更和补丁数量

segments.en: is five, tenfold what we've ever seen before.
segments.zh: 是我们以往所见五到十倍。

segments.en: It shouldn't be a complete surprise to anyone that that doesn't always go well.
segments.zh: 这并不总能顺利运行，任何人都不应感到完全意外。

segments.en: But it doesn't mean it's a disaster.
So what we're seeing is, and we should be expecting for a while, some more downtime, some more outages in different areas,
segments.zh: 所以我们看到的是，而且我们应该预计一段时间内，会有更多停机，更多不同领域的中断，

segments.en: as we upgrade the tech stacks to the latest versions of different releases to putting the patches to the vulnerabilities.
segments.zh: 随着我们将技术栈升级到不同版本的最新版，为漏洞打补丁。

segments.en: And at the end of the day, it will make us all a lot more resilient word that we've all been learning.
segments.zh: 最终，这将使我们所有人都更有韧性，这是我们一直在学习的词。

segments.en: That's both emotional, mental, and physical.
segments.zh: 这包括情感、心理和身体上的。

segments.en: But it builds resiliency. And that's going to be very important, because these models are powerful.
segments.zh: 但这能建立韧性。这将非常重要，因为这些模型很强大。
